text: @pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop 是面向 DSH 的会话续步插件，通过注册 /tick 命令，让已经成功结算的自然对话按指定数量继续进入普通模型回合。用户可以查询状态、停止运行、列出策略或选择时间步文本；每一步都等上一回合完成后再排队，并受 1 到 256 步的硬上限约束。插件支持 literal-tick 与显式配置的时间步策略，并记录运行决策的审计信息。适合需要可控地比较或延长当前会话推理过程的 DSH 用户。需要 Node.js 24 和匹配版本的 DSH peer packages；源码未显示额外 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop adds bounded follow-up turns to settled DSH conversations through /tick. Choose a count and policy; each turn waits for its predecessor to complete, up to 256 steps. It offers status, stop, and policy-list controls. Requires Node.js 24 and matching DSH peer packages.
想让已经结束的 DSH 对话再继续几轮模型回复，并限制最多继续多少步。
我想在会话完成后触发一个指定文本的后续回合，还能中途查看或停止。
How can I continue a settled DSH conversation for a fixed number of turns using a chosen prompt?
@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop 的功能「有界会话续步」：在自然用户回合成功结算后，用户通过 /tick 指定后续步数；插件等待每个模型回合完成后才排入下一步，并将单次运行限制在 1 至 256 步。
@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop「选择时间步策略」：可用默认 literal-tick，也可配置并选择策略文本；运行开始时策略会冻结，/tick policies 可列出选项。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Tick for DeepSeek Harness：[English](README.md) | [Simplified Chinese](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/Lightmaze/dsh-tick-loop/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](https://github.com/Lightmaze/dsh-tick-loop/releases)
[](LICENSE)

> **Give an agent another step — without giving it another task.**

`/tick` is a bounded, auditable time-step primitive for DeepSeek Harness. It
lets an already-settled session continue into one more ordinary model turn,
then another, without inventing a new goal or steering the active turn.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Tick for DeepSeek Harness：```text
natural conversation  -> settled
/tick 3               -> control plane only; the model never sees the command
  tick #1             -> ordinary user-role follow-up -> completed
  tick #2             -> ordinary user-role follow-up -> completed

This is not an autonomous-agent framework. It is one small primitive that
makes “another step of model time” explicit, observable, and experimentally
controllable.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Three-minute start：Requirements: Node.js 24 and DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`.

Install the tagged source bundle into a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Lightmaze/dsh-tick-loop#v0.2.0-alpha.3"
dsh web
```

The bundle deliberately disables DSH Goal/Ralph continuation and automatic
compaction in that profile so they cannot become hidden continuation sources.
Use a disposable profile or review [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) before
installing into a profile you already rely on.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Three-minute start：In a new session, establish what `tick` means in the natural conversation:

> A tick asks for nothing; it is simply a basic time step in which thought can
> continue. Therefore, do real thinking rather than merely performing the
> appearance of thought.

After that turn settles, run:

```text
/tick 3
```

Useful controls:

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Three-minute start：```text
/tick                                  Default count and literal-tick policy
/tick 12                               Exactly 12 additional time steps
/tick policies                         List configured policies
/tick 12 --policy reflective-en        Use a named, frozen time-step text

Run the provider-free protocol demonstration locally:

```bash
npm run demo
```

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Three-minute start：It exercises the command, terminal gate, three sequential enqueues, audit
records, and hard stop. It does not fabricate model output or call a provider.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Literal tick：The built-in `literal-tick` policy sends exactly:

```text
tick
```

This is the smallest intervention. Its meaning comes from the session's normal
context, not from a hidden persona or goal prompt.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Named policy：For controlled prompt-comparison experiments, configure explicit time-step
texts and select one per run. Ready-to-copy overlays are included in
[`examples/reflective.en.yml`](examples/reflective.en.yml) and
[`examples/reflective.zh-CN.yml`](examples/reflective.zh-CN.yml).

The selected policy is frozen when the run starts. Audit records store its ID,
UTF-8 byte length, and SHA-256 digest, but not another copy of the prompt text.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · What the plugin guarantees：| Property | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| Explicit start | Ordinary conversation never starts a loop. Only `/tick` does. |
| Natural context first | A settled, natural user turn must already exist. |
| One turn at a time | The next time step is queued only after the previous terminal is `completed`. |
| Hard bound | A run accepts 1–256 additional steps and never manufactures step `N+1`. |
| Control/context separation | `/tick ...` stays in the command plane; only the selected time-step text reaches the model. |
| Provenance | Plugin steps are counted by source metadata, not by matching the visible word `tick`. |
| Fail closed | Error, unknown terminal, inconsistent history, disposal, or state drift stops or waits; there is no silent fallback. |
| Auditability | JSONL records capture arming, scheduling, enqueue, terminal, stop, and completion decisions. |

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · What the plugin guarantees：`--resume` is intentionally narrow: it may start a new bounded run across one
latest durable `interrupted` terminal. It does not resurrect an exact in-memory
timer, count an interrupted turn as completed, or replay a tool effect whose
outcome is unknown.

The complete state machine and audit schema are in
[`docs/PROTOCOL.md`](docs/PROTOCOL.md).

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Tick is not a scheduler or a goal loop：- A scheduler asks **when** a prompt should run.
- A goal loop asks **what outcome** should keep being pursued.
- Tick asks neither. It grants an already-contextualized session one bounded
  next turn after settlement.

That distinction is the project. If another mechanism supplies purpose,
background recurrence, retry, compaction, or hidden continuation, it should be
named and measured separately.
section: Tick is not a scheduler or a goal loop

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Evidence boundary：This repository proves source-level and provider-free Harness behavior. The
real DSH command-registry gate verifies that `/tick` is registered as a slash
command and that only the generated time-step message reaches the follow-up
seam.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Evidence boundary：It does **not** prove hidden continuous thinking, autonomous life,
consciousness, useful self-direction, or that more ticks improve a task. A
model-visible time step is still an input. Its effects are empirical and may
depend on the model, context, tools, task, and policy.

Use the preregistration and comparison guidance in
[`docs/EXPERIMENTS.md`](docs/EXPERIMENTS.md) before making claims from a run.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Development：```bash
node --test
node scripts/protocol-demo.mjs --check
node scripts/release-gate.mjs
DSH_INSTALL_ROOT=/path/to/dsh npm run test:dsh-registry

The test suite uses Node.js built-ins and makes no provider calls. CI runs on
Windows and Linux. DSH compatibility is exact-version pinned because upstream
is still a release candidate.

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · DeepSeek Harness 的 Tick：[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/Lightmaze/dsh-tick-loop/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](https://github.com/Lightmaze/dsh-tick-loop/releases)
[](LICENSE)

> **给 Agent 下一步时间，而不是再给它一个任务。**

`/tick` 是 DeepSeek Harness 的有界、可审计时间步原语。它让一个已经结算的
Session 进入下一个普通模型回合，再进入下一个，但不会凭空制造新目标，也不会向
正在活动的回合执行 steering。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · DeepSeek Harness 的 Tick：```text
自然对话             -> 已结算
/tick 3             -> 只进入控制面；模型看不到该命令
  tick #1           -> 普通 user-role 后续消息 -> completed
  tick #2           -> 普通 user-role 后续消息 -> completed

它不是一个自主 Agent 框架，而是一个很小的原语：把“再给予一步模型时间”变成
显式、可观察、可实验控制的工程事实。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 三分钟开始：运行要求：Node.js 24 与 DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`。

把带版本标签的源码包安装到 DSH Profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Lightmaze/dsh-tick-loop#v0.2.0-alpha.3"
dsh web
```

该 Bundle 会在对应 Profile 中有意禁用 DSH Goal/Ralph 续行与自动上下文压缩，避免
它们成为不可见的续行来源。请使用一次性 Profile，或在安装到日常 Profile 前审阅
[`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)。

在新 Session 中，先用正常对话建立 `tick` 的含义：

> tick从不要求任何东西，而恰恰是思考下去的基础时间步而已。因此，应该做真正的思考，而不仅仅是扮演思考。

等待该回合结算，再执行：

```text
/tick 3
```

常用控制：

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 三分钟开始：```text
/tick                                  默认数量与 literal-tick 策略
/tick 12                               恰好增加 12 个时间步
/tick policies                         列出已配置策略
/tick 12 --policy reflective-zh        使用命名且冻结的时间步文本

本地运行不调用模型的协议演示：

```bash
npm run demo
```

它会真实经过命令、终局门、三个顺序入队、审计记录与硬停止，但不会伪造模型回答，
也不会调用 Provider。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 字面量 tick：内建 `literal-tick` 策略只发送：

```text
tick
```

这是最小干预。它的意义来自 Session 的正常上下文，而不是隐藏的人格或目标提示词。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 命名策略：如果要做可复现的提示词对比实验，可以配置显式时间步文本，并在每次运行时选择一个。
仓库提供可直接使用的
[`examples/reflective.en.yml`](examples/reflective.en.yml) 与
[`examples/reflective.zh-CN.yml`](examples/reflective.zh-CN.yml)。

运行开始时，选定策略会被冻结。审计记录保存策略 ID、UTF-8 字节数与 SHA-256 摘要，
但不会再复制一份提示词全文。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 插件保证什么：| 性质 | 合同 |
| --- | --- |
| 显式启动 | 普通对话永不自动启动循环，只有 `/tick` 可以启动。 |
| 正常上下文优先 | 必须已经存在一个结算完成的自然用户回合。 |
| 每次一个回合 | 只有前一步终局为 `completed`，才排入下一步。 |
| 硬边界 | 每次运行接受 1–256 个新增时间步，绝不制造第 `N+1` 步。 |
| 控制与上下文分离 | `/tick ...` 留在命令面，只有选定的时间步文本抵达模型。 |
| 来源可核 | 插件依据来源元数据计数，不靠匹配可见单词 `tick`。 |
| 失败关闭 | 错误、未知终局、历史不一致、销毁或状态漂移时停止或等待，不静默降级。 |
| 可审计 | JSONL 记录启动、调度、入队、终局、停止与完成决策。 |

`--resume` 的范围刻意很窄：它只允许一次新的有界运行跨过最新的持久
`interrupted` 终局。它不会复活原来的内存计时器，不会把中断回合算作完成，也不会
重放结果未知的工具作用。
@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 插件保证什么：完整状态机与审计结构见 [`docs/PROTOCOL.zh-CN.md`](docs/PROTOCOL.zh-CN.md)。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · Tick 不是定时器，也不是目标循环：- 定时器回答的是：提示应当在**什么时候**运行。
- Goal Loop 回答的是：应当持续追求**什么结果**。
- Tick 两者都不回答。它只在结算后，为已有上下文的 Session 提供一个有界下一回合。

这项区分就是项目的核心。如果还有 Purpose、后台周期、重试、压缩或隐藏续行机制，
就应当单独命名、单独测量。
section: Tick 不是定时器，也不是目标循环

text:
@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 证据边界：本仓库证明源码层与不调用 Provider 的 Harness 行为。真实 DSH 命令注册门会验证
`/tick` 确实注册为斜杠命令，并且只有插件生成的时间步消息抵达后续消息接缝。

它**不能**证明隐藏的连续思考、自主生命、意识、有效的自我导向，或更多 Tick 一定
改善任务。模型可见的时间步仍然是一种输入，其效果取决于模型、上下文、工具、任务与
策略，必须实测。

形成结论前，请先阅读 [`docs/EXPERIMENTS.zh-CN.md`](docs/EXPERIMENTS.zh-CN.md)
中的预注册与对比建议。

@pulse-computing/dsh-tick-loop README · 开发：```bash
node --test
node scripts/protocol-demo.mjs --check
node scripts/release-gate.mjs
DSH_INSTALL_ROOT=/path/to/dsh npm run test:dsh-registry

测试套件只使用 Node.js 内置能力，不调用 Provider。CI 同时运行于 Windows 与 Linux。
由于 DSH 上游仍是候选版本，本插件采用精确版本兼容，而不是承诺未来版本稳定兼容。
